title: %padLeft — left-pad to a width
purpose: Pad the start of a string with a fill character until it reaches a target length.
notes: Three required arguments: string, target length, fill character.
Only the first character of the fill argument is used. A string already at or above the length is returned unchanged.

avoid.why: omitting the fill-character argument fails the 3-argument requirement and yields null (~), not space-padding
